audience: webinar hosts and event teams that run sessions in Livestorm

useCases.title: See the sessions planned for next week
useCases.text: List the sessions across the workspace, filtered by status and date range. Open one session to read its start time and timezone.

useCases.title: Check who attended a session
useCases.text: List the registrants of one session, filtered to people who attended. Open one person to read their details.

useCases.title: Read the questions asked in a webinar
useCases.text: List the sessions of an event, then list the questions attendees asked in one session.

useCases.title: Find the recordings of a past session
useCases.text: List the sessions, then list the recordings of one session. Each recording link is signed and expires after a set number of seconds.

useCases.title: Draft a new event with its first session
useCases.text: Create a draft event, then add one session with a start time and timezone. Each call creates one record.

useCases.title: Review team members and registration fields
useCases.text: List the team members, including pending invitations. List the custom people attributes that the workspace uses on registration.
